title: What a moderate looks like
gist: Paywalled preview of a Yglesias mailbag: he argues aggressive GOP gerrymanders like North Carolina's are not 'dummymanders' because they maximize seats in mildly hostile environments (failing only in a D+13 wave), and that the progressive establishment exists to prevent an Obama-like figure such as James Talarico from bypassing the groups.

insights.claim: Aggressive Republican gerrymanders like North Carolina's were not optimal in the 2026 D+13 national environment, but are not 'dumb' because they maximize seats in a mildly hostile climate.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: Gerrymanders cap seat losses in normal swings, making House control sticky outside wave years.
insights.quote: It’s certainly true that the North Carolina map was not optimal for maximizing G.O.P. seats in a D+13 national environment.

insights.claim: Nevada Democrats kept a comfortable lower-house majority in 2024 with 46 percent of the vote by narrowly winning many Las Vegas suburban seats.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: Illustrates how district maps decouple seat share from vote share.
insights.quote: the party retained a comfortable majority in 2024 with 46 percent of the vote in the lower house of the Nevada legislature

insights.claim: Had Democrats done 10 points worse in 2026, they would have been crushed on the congressional map, and partisan gerrymanders undermine accountability by insulating politicians from normal opinion swings.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: Reduced responsiveness to voters implies policy persistence until wave elections.
insights.quote: These gerrymanders undermine political accountability by making politicians feel immune to normal-sized swings in opinion

insights.claim: The purpose of the progressive establishment organizing project is to prevent another Obama-like figure who connects with the Democratic base and sidelines advocacy groups.
insights.speaker: Matthew Yglesias
insights.so_what: Expect progressive-group resistance to charismatic moderates like Talarico ahead of 2028.
insights.quote: The entire purpose of the Progressive Establishment organizing project is to prevent the emergence of another Obama-like figure
